app.name: SimpleERP
app.tagline: Home care — quotes, assistants and plannings

auth.mustChangePassword: You must choose a new password before continuing.

quote.author: Written by
quote.pricedOnSave: Amounts are recomputed by the server when you save.
quote.noLineYet: This quote has no service on it yet.
quote.autoRenewHint: When it expires, a new quote covering the same services is written for the period that follows, priced at the catalogue as it stands then. Nothing is renewed before expiry.
quote.lastDayHint: Inclusive: this day is still delivered.
quote.interruptedTooltip: Services after this day are neither planned nor billed; they stay visible on the quote.
quote.renewedTooltip: This quote was written automatically when the previous one expired.

hca.positionSetByAdmin: Set by an administrator, from the accounts screen
hca.addressNotResolved: Your address could not be located. Until it is, you will not be included in the planning computation.
hca.licenceAffectsRouting: Decides the travel speed the planning computation routes you at.
hca.photoIsYourPin: Your photograph is your pin on the intervention map.
hca.promoteExplain: {{name}} will be able to validate quotes and manage assistants. An administrator can reverse this.
hca.workingDaysHint: The days of the week you work at all. A day left off is not an absence — it is a standing arrangement, and the planner never schedules you on it.
hca.workingDaysEmpty: Select at least one day. A week with no working day cannot be saved.

customer.noneAssigned: No customer has been assigned to you yet.
customer.name: Customer
customer.addressNotResolved: This address could not be located: no planning run will route to this home until it is corrected.
customer.addressIsRouted: This is where the care is delivered, and the address every planning run routes to.

planning.nobodyPlanned: No assistant has a visit in this period.
planning.runPending: The computation is running; this screen updates itself.
planning.retypeReprices: Changing the service reprices the quote, VAT included.
planning.deleteVisitExplain: “{{name}}” on {{day}} will be taken off the planning and off the service billed for. The quote is repriced and the planning recomputed.
planning.settingsSubtitle: The working day, the midday break and how far an assistant may be sent.
planning.settingsAppliesNextRun: Changes apply to the next planning run. Calendars already computed are left as they are.
planning.workingDayHint: No visit starts before this, and none ends after it.
planning.lunchHint: An uninterrupted break every assistant gets on a day they work.
planning.radiusHint: How far from their own home an assistant may be sent.
planning.settingsRadiusInvalid: The radius must be greater than zero.
planning.settingsLunchTooShort: The break must be at least 60 minutes.
planning.settingsDayInverted: The working day must end after it starts.
planning.settingsLunchInverted: The break window must end after it starts.
planning.settingsLunchOutsideDay: The break window must fall inside the working day.
planning.settingsLunchWindowTooNarrow: The break window is too narrow to hold the break.

common.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.

company.registerIntro: You will be the administrator of the agency you create.
company.name: Trading name
company.registrationNumberHelp: Optional — you can add it later.
company.registerUnavailable: Creating an agency is not enabled on this installation.
company.registerConflict: That agency name or email address is already taken.
company.title: My agency
company.registrationNumberHint: Optional: not every agency has been issued one yet.
company.contactEmailHint: Where applicants for an assistant post write.
company.acceptingApplicationsHint: Decides whether the agency appears on the list an applicant chooses from. Closing it does not discard applications already submitted: somebody who applied yesterday is still waiting for an answer.
company.administratorOnly: Only an administrator may view and change the agency's details.
company.legalIdentityHint: What a quote must state about the agency making the offer. Left blank, it simply does not appear on the document.
company.legalFormHint: SARL, SAS, Association, and so on.

account.title: Account
account.emailHint: This is the address you sign in with.
account.positionLocked: The position is granted by an administrator, from the workforce screen.
account.activeLocked: Set by an administrator. You cannot withdraw it from yourself: nothing would be left to undo it with.
account.assistantRecordLocked: The binding to an assistant record is made by a manager when the account is created.
account.agencyLocked: The agency is fixed when the account is created.
account.currentPasswordHint: Asked for even when signed in: it is what tells you apart from somebody who found your session open.
account.noAssistantRecordExplained: This account is bound to no assistant record, so it has no schedule and no customer portfolio. What is above — your photo, your details and your password — is everything the system holds about you.
account.photoExplained: Your photo is shown beside your name to your colleagues. JPEG, PNG or WebP.

catalog.title: Catalogue and rates
catalog.name: Label
catalog.categorySetsVat: The category decides which VAT rate applies.
catalog.rulesAreConfiguration: These rules live in the deployment's configuration rather than here: changing what every service costs is a commercial decision, not a form. What an individual service charges is editable below.
catalog.retiredExplained: A retired service is no longer offered when writing a quote, but stays readable on quotes already written.
catalog.codeIsFixed: Fixed: every quote line already written refers to it.
catalog.emptyMeansAgencyRate: Empty = the agency rate ({{rate}} € excl. VAT).
catalog.rateMustBePositive: The rate must be a strictly positive number.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.label: Label
certifications.retiredExplained: A retired certification is still held by those who hold it, but can no longer be required of a new service.
certifications.whatThisIs: The qualifications the agency recognises. A service may require one: only assistants holding it, unexpired on the day of the visit, can be scheduled on that work.
certifications.requiredHint: None by default. Only assistants holding every certification chosen can be scheduled.
certifications.overrideForThisLine: Require something else for this line

skills.title: Skill catalogue
skills.label: Name
skills.codeHint: Letters, digits, - and _ only. Cannot be changed later.
skills.codeIsFixed: Fixed: every declared skill and requirement is matched on it.
skills.retiredExplained: A retired skill can no longer be required or declared. Everybody who already declared it keeps it.
skills.whatThisIs: The skills the agency recognises. Assistants declare their own from their account page, and a service can require one — the planner will only assign work to somebody who has declared it.
skills.requiredHint: Hold Ctrl (or Cmd) to select several. Only somebody who has declared all of them can be given this work.
skills.inheritsFromService: Use the skills the service requires
skills.mineExplained: You declare these yourself and they take effect immediately. Your managers are notified of every one you add, and can withdraw it.
skills.noneDeclared: You have not declared any skill yet.

hcas.fieldEmployeeHint: Cleared, this person is no longer placed on interventions. Their record, their quotes and their account are unchanged.
hcas.deleteWarning: The record and the sign-in account bound to it are removed for good. Their remaining visits will be replanned.
hcas.workingDaysManagerHint: The days of the week this person works at all — a day left off is a standing arrangement, not an absence. Saturday and Sunday may be selected like any other day.

customers.deleteWarning: The customer and every quote written for them are removed for good, along with the visits scheduled from them. This cannot be undone: for a customer who is stopping the service, set their status to “stopped” instead.
